content: 1. Are there any indications of threatened or actual legal challenges by private sector entities against the government in relation to public health measures? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 2. Are there any indications of practices or behaviors by private sector entities that oppose, undermine, weaken, or delay public health measures, particularly those designed to prevent or control non-communicable diseases (NCDs)? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 3. Does the private sector actor have relevant policies and/or take concrete steps to promote fair labor practices in its operations and interactions with suppliers and business partners? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 4. Does the private sector actor have relevant policies and/or a monitoring system to prevent, minimize, and remedy adverse environmental and health safety impacts of its activities? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 5. Does the private sector actor have relevant policies and/or a monitoring system to assess the social and environmental performance of its business partners and suppliers? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 6. Does the private sector actor have relevant policies and/or take concrete steps to prevent corruption, including extortion and bribery, at any time or in any form, in its interactions with suppliers, intermediaries, governments, and business partners? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 7. Does the private sector entity have a positive track record of complying with, and not opposing, resisting, or seeking to undermine or delay, government measures, policies, or laws promoting public health, particularly those for the prevention and control of NCDs? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 8. Does the private sector actor make explicit commitments to align its business plans, actions, and investments with Sustainable Development Goal 3 and/or specific national or subnational NCD goals? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 9. Does the private sector actor have relevant policies and/or take concrete steps to promote and/or create safe and healthy environments for its workers? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 10. If the private sector entity is involved in the production and/or commercialization of products and/or services that contribute to the prevalence of modifiable behavioral risk factors for NCDs (e.g., tobacco use, physical inactivity, unhealthy diet, harmful use of alcohol), or have an adverse impact on the determinants of health, or harm public health, the government should exercise caution in proceeding with the engagement. If engagement is necessary due to public health policy implementation, the government must exercise particular caution when considering possible engagements, or limit engagement to consultations and dialogues. 11. Does the private sector entity take concrete steps to eliminate all exposure of children to the marketing of foods and non-alcoholic beverages consistent with national and/or international guidance on healthy diets? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 12. Does the private sector entity have clear goals and take concrete steps to reformulate its foods and non-alcoholic beverages, where possible, consistent with national and/or international guidance on healthy diets? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 13. Does the private sector entity take concrete steps to declare nutrients in line with Codex Alimentarius guidelines on nutrition labeling? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 14. Does the private sector entity comply with all applicable international and national laws and policies on food labeling, including nutrition labeling (whether the system is mandatory or voluntary)? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 15. Does the private sector entity comply with all applicable national laws and policies on the marketing of foods and non-alcoholic beverages? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 16. Does the private sector entity comply with all applicable national laws and policies on food reformulation to reduce salt and/or sugars and to eliminate trans fats? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 17. Does the private sector entity comply with all applicable national laws and policies on consumer information and protection? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 18. Does the private sector entity have relevant policies and/or take concrete steps to improve access to and affordability of safe, effective, and quality medicines and health technologies in the prevention and control of NCDs? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 19. Does the private sector entity comply with applicable national laws and policies on the marketing of medicines and health technologies to providers and consumers? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 20. Does the private health-care provider have a record of compliance with requirements to report to the national health information and management system? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 21. Does the private health-care provider have a track record of adhering to quality and safety standards as defined by relevant regulatory authorities? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 22. Does the private health-care provider currently hold a license issued by a relevant national authority to provide health services? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 23. Is the private health-care provider accredited by a relevant national or international authority? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 24. Does the private sector actor have relevant policies or practices regarding patient-centric care and respect for patients’ rights in relation to dignity, privacy, and confidentiality? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 25. Does the private health-care provider have relevant policies, structures, or activities that contribute to evidence-based practice and quality improvement of its services? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 26. Does the private sector actor publicly disclose the composition of its board members, shareholders, investors, donors, and funding sources? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 27. Does the private sector actor have board members, shareholders, and/or investors not at arm’s length to other private sector actors that are excluded from engagement by the government? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 28. Does the private sector actor disclose financial information, including tax returns and financial statements, in accordance with applicable laws? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 29. Has the private sector actor complied in the past with the terms of engagement and conditions agreed upon with the public sector, including any government sector or agency? If yes, state accordingly. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 30. Does the private sector actor have relevant policies or procedures on compliance, ethics, and accountability that include appropriate practice and behavior regarding interactions with public officials? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 31. Does the private sector actor offer relevant training for its staff and partners on appropriate practice and behavior regarding interactions with public officials? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unknown, state accordingly. 32. What is the likelihood of risks occurring as part of the engagement, and what impact will they have on the government’s ability to maintain its integrity and independence? Use a risk assessment matrix to evaluate the likelihood and impact of risks such as conflicts of interest, reputational risks, governance risks, political risks, and operational risks. 33. Have the challenges that hinder progress towards achieving the NCD goals been identified? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unclear, state accordingly. 34. Does the government require complementary resources (financial or non-financial) from the private sector to address the NCD challenges? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unclear, state accordingly. 35. Is the selected type of engagement the most appropriate for the purpose of the engagement? If yes, provide details to the extent possible. If no or unclear, state accordingly.
